'''Varian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Major/Legends|major]] of the [[House of Thul|House Thul's]] military who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], he ran a small shop, where he built and sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weaponry.
